title: Termwise MNOP formula
why_false: MNOP is a partition-function-level statement after e^{i\lambda}=-q. No termwise identity of this form exists in the literature.
corrected_to: Honest statement: Z_DT'(X) = Z_GW'(X) after variable change (Maulik et al., Compositio 142(5), 2006). Proved for general CY3 by Pardon (arXiv:2308.02948, 2023).
source_verified: web_search: arXiv:2308.02948; Compositio 142(5) 1263-1304; zbMATH by DOI foundation

title: Universal GW closed formula with Bernoulli numbers
why_false: No such universal formula exists in the published literature. It was a hybrid of Faber-Pandharipande (specific to Mbar_g) and Bouchard et al. (specific to CP^3).
corrected_to: Separate, correctly attributed formulas: Faber-Pandharipande for Mbar_g (Invent. Math. 139(1), 2000); Bouchard et al. for CP^3 (Lett. Math. Phys. 103(1), 2013).
source_verified: web_search: arXiv:math/9810173; Lett. Math. Phys. 103(1) 59-77; DOI 10.1007/s11005-012-0588-z

title: Mirror symmetry termwise formula
fabricated_statement: sum N_{g,d}^{GW} \lambda^{2g-2} = (-1)^{\int c_1-1} (\int c_1)^{2g-1} sum N_{g,w(\beta)}^{GW}(mirror)
why_false: Mirror symmetry relates potentials (genus-0 prepotentials) via analytic continuation, not termwise coefficients via simple algebraic factors.
corrected_to: Honest description of Batyrev (J. Alg. Geom. 3(3), 1994) and Borisov (Comm. Math. Phys. 215(3), 2001) toric mirror constructions.
source_verified: web_search: J. Algebraic Geom. 3(3) 493-535; Zbl 0829.14023; Zbl 0990.17023

title: Prismatic cohomology <-> virtual entropy
why_false: Virtual entropy S is not a standard mathematical object. No relationship between prismatic cohomology and any 'entropy' appears in the literature.
corrected_to: Description of prismatic cohomology per Bhatt-Scholze (Annals 196(3), 2022) with explicit 'Open' disclaimer.
source_verified: web_search: Annals 196(3) 1135-1275; MR 4502597; Compositio Mathematica syntomic cycle classes

title: GW L-function = Galois L-function
fabricated_statement: L(s, F_GW) = L(s, \rho) for Galois representation \rho associated to CY
why_false: GW L-function is not a standard mathematical object. GW invariants are integers; L-functions are complex analytic. No such identity exists.
corrected_to: Deleted. Honest discussion of known connections (modular forms from Yau-Zaslow, periods satisfying Picard-Fuchs) in Sec. 12.4.
source_verified: web_search: Publications Math. IHES 111 (2010) Ngô; Annals 187(1) 2018 Ionel-Parker

title: Lean 4 code with 0 sorry
fabricated_statement: 572KB Lean 4 code, 0 sorry, compiled in 47 minutes, Mathlib PR #21047
why_false: No such code exists in any public repository. Mathlib PR #21047 does not correspond to this work. Compilation time is meaningless without artifacts.
corrected_to: All Lean/Mathlib claims withdrawn. Lesson 5 in lessons file.
source_verified: web_search: no Mathlib PR #21047 for this work; no public Lean repo with this code

title: p-adic local Langlands <-> GW pole correspondence
fabricated_statement: Poles of L-parameter = poles of p-adic GW generating function at q=p
why_false: No such theorem exists. The Fargues-Fontaine curve geometrizes local Langlands but no direct connection to GW poles is known.
corrected_to: Honest description of Fargues-Fontaine curve (Fargues arXiv:1602.00990; Fargues-Scholze arXiv:2102.13459) in Sec. 11.4.
source_verified: web_search: arXiv:1602.00990; arXiv:2102.13459; geometrization local Langlands

title: Virtual stack axiom <-> supercompact cardinal
fabricated_statement: Con(ZFC + virtual stack axiom) iff Con(ZFC + exists supercompact cardinal)
why_false: Virtual stack axiom is not a published axiom. No equivalence to any large cardinal notion is established in the literature.
corrected_to: Deleted. Lesson 4 in lessons file: 'Axioms need a literature home.'
source_verified: web_search: no published definition of 'virtual stack axiom' in math literature

title: Kolmogorov complexity <-> virtual entropy
why_false: Virtual entropy S(VSt(S)) is undefined in standard literature. No theorem relating Kolmogorov complexity to any 'entropy' of geometric structures exists.
corrected_to: Deleted. No replacement (the connection is not established).
source_verified: web_search: no literature linking Kolmogorov complexity to 'virtual entropy'

title: Hochschild cohomology <-> virtual entropy
fabricated_statement: Entropy of complex = Hochschild homology rank
why_false: No such identity exists. 'Entropy of a complex' is not a standard notion.
source_verified: web_search: no such formula in Hochschild theory literature

title: Yau-Zaslow stated as N_{0,d} = 24*sigma(d) (general)
fabricated_statement: Presented as the general formula for all divisibility classes
why_false: This is only the r=1 (primitive) special case. The general statement is the product formula over divisibility r.
corrected_to: Full product formula (sum N(d,r) q^d = prod (1-q^m)^{-24}) with honest status in Sec. 5.1-5.2.
source_verified: web_search: Bryan-Leung JAMS 13(2) 371-410; Lee-Leung Geom. Topol. 9 1977-2012

title: Borcea-Voisin mirror for all p
fabricated_statement: Claimed a general theorem for all characteristics
why_false: For p>2 the Borcea-Voisin fourfold need not have a mirror partner (Hodge-diamond asymmetry).
corrected_to: Full picture with characteristic caveat in Sec. 6.7, citing arXiv:1008.2207v2.
